question: On December 23, 2022, using land surface temperature (LST) derived from the Three-Temperature Method (TTM) applied to ASTER Bands 10–12 (acquired at 10:30 AM local time), estimate the mean LST difference (ΔLST) between two vertically aligned regions that partially overlap in longitude (74.4°–75.1°E).
final_answer_preview:
The mean land surface temperature (LST) difference (ΔLST) between the two regions is **0.312 K** (or **0.312°C** when converted to Celsius). This represents the difference in average LST values calculated using the Three-Temperature Method (TTM) applied to ASTER Bands 10–12 for December 23, 2022.

### Final Answer:
ΔLST = **0.312 K** (or **0.312°C**)
